Auth.signinLede: Sign in to access your financial dashboard
Auth.signupLede: Secure access to your financial reports, documents, and insights.
Auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to your inbox. Click it to activate your account, then sign in.
Auth.termsAgree: By creating an account you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
Auth.valuePropBody: Bookkeeping & tax, handled — see your Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and insights, download your reports, and ask Nick anything about your numbers.
Auth.forgotLede: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new one.
Auth.forgotLinkExpired: That reset link has expired. Request a new one below.
Auth.forgotSentBody: If an account exists for that address, we sent a password reset link. It expires in 1 hour.
Auth.resetLede: Choose a strong password to finish securing your account.
Auth.resetExpiredLede: This password reset link is invalid or has expired.
Auth.inviteLede: Set a password to activate your account and open your business portal.
Auth.inviteInvalidTitle: This invitation link is not valid
Auth.inviteInvalidBody: It may have expired or already been used. Ask your accountant for a new one, or sign in if you already activated your account.
Auth.inviteFailed: Could not set your password. Please try again.
Auth.testimonial1Quote: Hoyos Baker transformed the way we understand our finances. The reports are clear, the insights are practical, and we always know what needs our attention.
Auth.testimonial2Quote: Instead of trying to interpret spreadsheets, I can now see the financial health of my business in seconds.
Auth.testimonial3Quote: The dashboard gives us clarity over cash flow, taxes, and upcoming expenses without making accounting feel complicated.

AuthErrors.checkDetails: Please check your details and try again.
AuthErrors.createFailed: Could not create your account. Please try again.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.saveError: Could not save your changes. Please try again.
Settings.avatarBadType: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
Settings.bizLede: Your business details. These appear on reports and documents.
Settings.bizPermissionBanner: Only the business owner can edit these details.
Settings.bizNoPermission: You don't have permission to edit this business.
Settings.membersLede: People with access to this business.

Overview.subtitle: Here's how {business} is doing.
Overview.pendingTitle: Your accountant hasn't assigned a business yet
Overview.pendingBody: Once Hoyos Baker links your account to your business, your reports and insights will appear here.
Overview.emptyBody: Your accountant hasn't published any reports for {business}. Your Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and insights will appear here once they do.
Overview.howCashIn: Sum of all credits (money in) on your published bank statements for the period. Bank statements only — never the P&L.
Overview.howCashOut: Sum of all debits (money out) on your published bank statements for the period.
Overview.howNetCash: Cash In minus Cash Out for the period, from bank statements. This is cash movement, not profit.
Overview.howNetIncome: The Net Income line printed on your published Profit & Loss for this period. Revenue and expenses come from the P&L, not from the bank.
Overview.howRevenue: The total income / revenue line printed on your published Profit & Loss for this period.
Overview.cashChartSummary: Over {months} months: {totalIn} came in and {totalOut} went out. Best month for net cash: {bestMonth}.
Overview.cashChartUnavailable: Monthly cash needs published bank statements. Your accountant has not published any for this period yet.
Overview.cashIncompletePeriod: Cash totals are unavailable because published statements do not cover this entire period for every account. Missing days are never treated as zero.
Overview.reportsPageLede: Every report and original document your accountant has published for {business}.
Overview.insightsEmpty: Nothing to flag for this period.
Overview.expensesLede: Largest expense lines on the Profit & Loss, share of total expenses.
Overview.expensesEmpty: Publish a Profit & Loss to see expense composition.
Overview.incomeLede: Revenue (from the P&L) next to cash in (from the bank) — they are different things.
Overview.incomeEmpty: Needs a published Profit & Loss and bank statements for the same period.
Overview.previewBanner: Previewing the client portal for {business}. Clients see exactly this.
Overview.errorTitle: We couldn't load your financial data
Overview.errorBody: Try again. If this keeps happening, contact Hoyos Baker.

Admin.dashboardLedeAdmin: Clients, businesses, documents and everything awaiting your review.
Admin.dashboardLedeStaff: Read-only view of clients, businesses and documents.
Admin.deniedStaff: That action needs a master admin. Your role is read-only.
Admin.nextBody: Every number above is a live count. Upload documents, review what the pipeline extracted, and publish to clients from the Documents queue.
Admin.errorInvalid: Please check the details and try again.
Admin.errorSave: Could not save. Please try again.
Admin.clientsLede: People and companies the firm keeps the books for. Each client owns one or more businesses.
Admin.notesInternal: Internal notes (never shown to the client)
Admin.noClients: No clients yet. Create the first one to start uploading documents.
Admin.businessesCount: {count, plural, =0 {no businesses} one {# business} other {# businesses}}
Admin.salesTaxEnabled: Sales Taxes module (shows the Sales Taxes section to the client)
Admin.noBusinesses: No businesses yet for this client.
Admin.membersLede: Link an existing account by email, or invite someone new. Owners can edit the business profile; viewers are read-only.
Admin.memberNotFound: No account with that email. Send an invitation instead.
Admin.memberExists: That person already has access to this business.
Admin.memberAlreadyHasAccount: That email already has an account — link it instead.
Admin.notesLede: Internal notes about this business. Clients never see them.
Admin.noDocuments: No documents uploaded for this business yet.
Admin.name: Name
Admin.auditLede: Who did what, on which business, and when. Identifiers only — never document content or figures.
Admin.documentsQueueLede: Every upload across all businesses, by processing status.
Admin.errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
Admin.uploadLede: Pick the client and business, then add bank statements, financial statements, tax documents or CSV exports. Files are processed automatically and land in the review queue.
Admin.dropzone: Drag PDF or CSV files here, or
Admin.fileBadType: Only PDF and CSV files are accepted.
Admin.reject_duplicate: This exact file was already uploaded for this business.
Admin.reject_pdf_invalid: The file is not a readable PDF.
Admin.reject_pdf_encrypted: The PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and upload again.
Admin.reject_pdf_too_large: The PDF is too large to process (max 30 MB).
Admin.reject_pdf_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages (max 200).
Admin.reject_csv_unparseable: The CSV needs a header row and at least one data row.
Admin.reject_missing_object: The upload did not complete. Try again.
Admin.reject_save_failed: Could not save the file record. Try again.
Admin.noPagesYet: Pages are classified when the processing job runs.
Admin.noExtraction: Nothing has been extracted for this version yet.
Admin.reconciliationFailed: Checks failing — correct the lines below
Admin.lowConfidenceCount: {count, plural, =0 {No low-confidence lines} one {# low-confidence line} other {# low-confidence lines}}
Admin.publishBlockedStatus: The document must be reconciled before it can be published.
Admin.publishBlockedReconciliation: A report attached to this version fails reconciliation.
Admin.publishBlockedLowConfidence: Low-confidence lines must be corrected first.
Admin.publishBlockedNoData: Nothing was extracted from this version; publish is not possible.
Admin.publishedNote: Clients can see this document and its report(s). Unpublish to hide them again.
Admin.reviewBlocked: Fix the failing checks and low-confidence lines first.
Admin.supersededNote: This version replaced an earlier published report; the previous one stays in history as superseded.
Admin.runJobsDone: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing pending} one {Processed # job} other {Processed # jobs}}
Admin.replacingDocument: New version of “{title}” — the current version stays visible to the client until this one is reviewed and published.
Admin.remindersLede: Deadlines and payments the client will see on their Overview. Unpublished reminders stay private to the firm.
Admin.noReminders: No reminders for this business yet.

Mfa.enrollLede: The firm portal requires an authenticator app. Scan the code with Google Authenticator, 1Password or similar, then enter the 6-digit code.
Mfa.verifyLede: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to open the firm portal.
Mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
Mfa.codeInvalid: That code is not valid. Check the app and try again.
Mfa.enrollFailed: Could not start the setup. Reload the page and try again.

Reminders.title: Reminders & obligations
Reminders.lede: Upcoming payroll, tax deadlines, loan payments and anything else your accountant wants you to know about.

Statements.pnlLede: Revenue, costs and profit for the period, exactly as published by your accountant.
Statements.bsLede: What the business owns and owes as of the statement date.
Statements.noReport: No published {type} for this period yet.
Statements.noReportsAtAll: Your accountant has not published a {type} yet. It will appear here as soon as one is published.
Statements.drawerNoPrior: This statement has no comparative column.
Statements.explainTotal: A printed subtotal: the sum of the lines above it in this section, as shown on the statement.
Statements.explainSection: A section heading that groups the lines below it.
Statements.explainLine: An account as printed on the statement. Current and prior amounts are transcribed from the document and reconciled by your accountant.
Statements.trendUnavailable: Trends appear once two or more periods are published.
Statements.granularityNote: Monthly and quarterly views are not available: this statement covers {period} as a whole. Nothing is estimated.
Statements.reason_no_prior_column: No comparative column on this statement
Statements.reason_no_prior_total: No prior figure for this line
Statements.reason_missing_inputs: Needs a total this statement does not print
Statements.granularityNoteAsOf: Monthly and quarterly views are not available: a balance sheet is a snapshot as of {date}. Nothing is estimated.

Insights.revenue_up_collections_down_title: Revenue grew but cash collected fell
Insights.revenue_up_collections_down_body: Revenue is up {revenuePct}% while cash in is down {cashPct}% versus the prior period. Worth checking receivables.
Insights.payroll_share_up_title: Payroll is taking a bigger share of revenue
Insights.payroll_share_up_body: Payroll went from {priorPct}% to {currentPct}% of revenue.
Insights.outflow_exceeded_inflow_title: More cash went out than came in
Insights.outflow_exceeded_inflow_body: Net cash flow was {net} for the period.
Insights.report_needs_review_body: {count, plural, one {# document is} other {# documents are}} with your accountant for review and will appear once published.
